Context: 8. Disbursement of advance and time-limits for utilization.-

- (c) For construction / expansion of living accommodation, etc. Payable in two instalments of 50% each. The first instalment will be paid after the plot and proposed house/ existing house is mortgaged and the balance on the construction-reaching plinth level. - Rule 8 (iii).
- (d) For expansion to be carried out on the upper storey of the house. Disbursed in two instalments, first instalment on executing the mortgage deed and the second instalment on the construction reaching roof-level.  
- Rule 8 (iv).
